trust.label: Keep this device trusted

unavailable.title: Could not complete the request
unavailable.body: Something went wrong. Try again, and tell your system administrator if it keeps happening.

login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use your work email. We will ask for a verification code after your password.

invalid.title: Those sign-in details are not correct
invalid.body: Check your work email and password, then try again.

locked.title: Account temporarily locked
locked.body: You have used all the allowed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.

resetDone.body: Sign in with the new password. We will ask for a verification code again.

restricted.title: Access is limited to organisation accounts
restricted.body: If you do not have an account, ask your system administrator to add you and set your role and department.

login.auditNote: Every sign-in attempt is recorded in the security log with the device, the network and the time.

workflow.title: How work moves through the system
workflow.body: The SEO department creates tasks and dispatches them to the two delivery teams. The system follows every task from creation to approval, and scores its quality from the task's own data.
workflow.rejectionPath: And if a task does not meet its requirements: Rejected → Needs revision → Resubmitted → In review.

code.title: Enter your verification code
code.lede: We sent a six-digit code, valid for {minutes} minutes, to
code.label: Verification code
code.pasteHint: You can paste the whole code into the first box.
code.resent: We sent a new code to your inbox.
code.policyNote: You can ask for another code after {seconds} seconds. After {attempts} failed attempts the account is locked for {minutes} minutes and the event is recorded in the security log.

invalid.title: That code is not correct
invalid.body: Check the six digits against the message and try again.

expired.title: That code has expired
expired.body: This code is past its validity window. Ask for a new one to finish signing in.

exhausted.title: No attempts left on this code
exhausted.body: This code's attempts are used up. Ask for a new code to continue.

locked.title: Account temporarily locked
locked.body: We locked the account after several wrong codes, and recorded it in the security log. Try again once the window ends.

challengeExpired.title: The verification session has ended
challengeExpired.body: Too long has passed since you entered your password. Sign in again.

noAccess.title: Cannot reach your inbox?
noAccess.body: Contact your system administrator to reset your verification method.

why.title: Why the extra step
why.body: A password alone is enough for anyone who obtains it. A temporary code ties the sign-in to your inbox, and a trusted device makes that bearable day to day.
why.configurable: These values are editable from the two-factor settings, and changing them needs no code change.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.lede: Enter your work email and we will send a reset link. The link is valid for one hour and can be used once.

sent.title: The link has been sent if the address is registered
sent.body: Check your inbox and your junk folder. We do not disclose whether an address is registered in the system.

invalid.title: That email is not valid
invalid.body: Enter a correctly formed work email, such as name@nuwa.sa.

forgot.auditNote: Every recovery attempt is recorded with the device and the time. If you did not request it, ignore the message and tell your system administrator.

after.title: What happens after you send
after.receive: You receive a link valid for one hour
after.revoke: Every open session on your other devices is ended
after.signIn: You sign in again with a verification code
after.note: Resetting a password revokes trust on every saved device, because a trusted device rests on the account not having been compromised.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lede: You will be asked to sign in again after saving.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

invalidToken.title: That link is invalid or has expired
invalidToken.body: A recovery link can be used once and is valid for one hour. Ask for a new one.

reused.title: You have used that password before
reused.body: One of your recent passwords cannot be reused. Choose one you have not used.

warning.title: You will be signed out everywhere
warning.body: Saving a new password closes your open sessions and revokes trust on saved devices, on this device and others.

storage.title: How your password is stored
storage.body: The system never keeps the password itself. It stores a fingerprint derived from it with a deliberately slow algorithm built for the purpose, so the original cannot be recovered even from the database.

roles.title: Roles
roles.sub: A role is a set of permissions and nothing else. Adding one needs no change to the structure of the system — only a decision about what it may do.

meta.counted: {count, plural, =0 {no permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

explainer.title: How the permission model works
explainer.stringTitle: A permission is a string, not a test on the role
explainer.stringBody: Every control asks for a permission by name, such as tasks.assign, and never asks “is this user a manager?”. That is why a sixth role needs no screen to change.
explainer.groupsNote: A star means everything under the group. tasks.*, for instance, covers assigning, reviewing, approving and rejecting.
explainer.hideTitle: Hiding a button is not protection
explainer.hideBody: What you set here controls the interface only. In the running system every permission is checked again on the server when the action is performed, because hiding a control in the browser does not stop the request being sent.

errors.roleProtected: This role is protected and cannot be changed.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.sub: One permission per row, one role per column. The permission name is fixed in code, so editing this screen is enough to change how the whole system behaves.
permissions.lockedTitle: The system administrator column cannot be edited
permissions.lockedBody: That role always holds every permission, because a system with no administrator able to repair it becomes unmanageable. The trade is that everything it does is written to the audit log.
permissions.note: Why permissions are strings and not numbers: a string explains itself in the code and in the log, so a line like data-perm="tasks.approve" can be read without a reference table. Numbers need one, and break when the order changes.
permissions.restoreConfirm: The five original roles will go back to their default permissions and every change to them will be discarded. Roles you created are not affected.

errors.forbidden: You cannot grant a permission you do not hold yourself.
errors.roleProtected: The system administrator column cannot be edited.
errors.roleMissing: The roles changed since you opened this page. Refresh it.
errors.invalid: The submitted changes could not be read.
errors.error: The changes could not be saved. Try again.
